purpose: Concrete expression actions for eight relationships; adapt with actual scientific sources, approved art assets and voice events. No fabricated absolute audio timing.

recipes.name: Single-variable before/after change
prerequisites: Establish the object and relevant conditions first
Identify the only factor changed in this demonstration
fixed: Object identity, framing and other relevant conditions
sequence: Show the initial state
Introduce the changed factor
Show necessary intermediate processes
Leave observation time after the result appears
Connect the process back to the original phenomenon
scientific_risks: The change must not precede its cause
Time compression/slow motion does not represent actual speed
Do not invent visible intermediate stages
recipes.evidence: Pending actual project keyframes, actual audio timeline and continuous review; this recipe grants no approval.

recipes.name: Reference frame and viewpoint
prerequisites: Object identity, reference directions and relevant viewpoints
fixed: The object's world position or the spatial relationship under study
changed_or_revealed: Observer position, angle or local framing
sequence: Establish reference frame/viewpoint in the whole view
Make direction mappings explicit
Change only relevant observation conditions
Retain correspondence cues
Return to the whole to explain relative relations
scientific_risks: Screen left/right is not object left/right
Camera change does not establish object motion
Map auxiliary lines to actual entities first
recipes.evidence: Pending actual project keyframes, actual audio timeline and continuous review; this recipe grants no approval.

recipes.name: How structure produces function
prerequisites: Part names, connections and functional task
fixed: Object identity, connection points and scientific topology
changed_or_revealed: Functional part states, flow paths or interactions
sequence: Locate parts in the whole
Move closer and explain cutaway/exterior correspondence
Show connections and constraints
Trace functional action through those connections
Return to the whole to answer what it does
scientific_risks: Naming a part does not explain function
Decorative color does not establish real material
Omitted internal details must not change the core function

recipes.name: Propagation carrier, path and transfer
prerequisites: Carrier, origin, path and the quantity or influence being transferred
fixed: Object identity, path reference, relevant medium and conditions
changed_or_revealed: Propagating states along the path and sequential responses at different positions
sequence: Locate origin, carrier and path first
Show the supported initial disturbance or transfer
Trace intermediate states with the same reference
Show relevant direction, delay and receiver response
Distinguish carrier motion from energy, information or disturbance propagation
scientific_risks: A wavefront does not automatically imply matter flying along the path
Order, direction and delay require scientific support
Explain time compression and schematic colors

recipes.name: Comparison under controlled conditions
prerequisites: Compared objects, common conditions and the difference to judge
fixed: Framing, scale, measurement basis and other relevant conditions
changed_or_revealed: One compared variable or an explainable group of variables
sequence: Establish two cases under the same conditions
Identify the different quantity
Show corresponding states simultaneously or sequentially
Identify the difference and inference conditions
Return to the original question with a qualified conclusion
scientific_risks: Do not change multiple hidden conditions and attribute the result to one variable
A local difference does not establish a universal conclusion
Same-screen positions/sizes must not imply an unsupported ratio
recipes.evidence: Pending actual project keyframes, actual audio timeline and continuous review; this recipe grants no approval.

recipes.name: Quantities and relationships
prerequisites: Meaning, units, reference and conditions of the quantities
fixed: Units, coordinate reference and comparison basis
changed_or_revealed: Independent variable and dependent variable determined by the relationship
sequence: Establish quantities with recognizable objects
Fix reference and units
Select a few supported states
Map numerical change to the actual relationship
Explain applicability and nonlinear/proportional limits
scientific_risks: Decorative size cannot stand in for quantitative proportion
Do not fill graphics with unsupported precise values
Animation interpolation cannot replace the actual function

recipes.name: Outcome distribution and uncertainty
prerequisites: Possible outcomes, definition of one trial and statistical basis
sequence: Establish one possible outcome
Distinguish one trial from repeated trials
Show a sourced or explicitly simulated distribution
Distinguish observed frequency from the probability model
Explain sample variation and inference limits
scientific_risks: Small samples do not guarantee theoretical proportions
A random demonstration is not empirical data
Do not highlight only successes or turn probability into certainty

recipes.name: What conclusion an observation supports
prerequisites: Actual observation, question to explain and comparison basis
fixed: Evidence identity, original scope and inference conditions
sequence: Present a verifiable observation
Identify directly observed facts
Establish the basis connecting facts to inference
Present competing explanations or limitations when applicable
Conclude in proportion to the evidence
scientific_risks: A schematic animation cannot masquerade as observational evidence
Correlation does not automatically prove causation
Retain unresolved alternatives and uncertainty
